name: Kiss or Kill
storyline:
■ 7 Days of Dating Show & 7 Judgments

200 participants are forced into groups.

Each team—one woman and three men—is thrown into a seven-day dating experiment.

By day, you build intimacy through “Heartflutter” tasks.

By night, you uncover secrets in the dark.

Every day, someone is eliminated.

And when the moment comes, you must choose...

to kiss… or kill.

■ Features

Branching paths / Multiple playthroughs / Multiple endings

Every choice is a line between love and death.

Six romanceable characters (3 male, 2 female, including a hidden route)

Every relationship is a gamble of intimacy or betrayal.

Dating show × Battle Royale tension

Is it the suspension bridge effect…

or a carefully designed killing game?
summary:
Kiss or Kill is a multi-route, multi-ending mystery thriller visual novel blending dating show drama with battle royale survival.

Trapped inside a "holographic simulation" styled as a reality romance show, you're watched at every moment by an AI host with absolute authority. One by one, deadly-sweet love challenges unfold — and failure isn't just embarrassing. It's fatal.

Six romanceable characters. One hidden route. And a razor-thin line between the thrill of danger and something that might actually be real.

Is it the adrenaline talking — or do you genuinely feel something?

Either way, the next elimination is coming.
